sections.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (2/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.
Tunneler. Burrowing through solid rock costs twice the normal movement and leaves a tunnel 15 ft. in diameter.
Unusual Nature. The dragon needs no air.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and its speed becomes 0 through the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and its speed stays the same.

sections.title: Bonus actions
lines: Phase (3/day). The dragon turns partly incorporeal while it maintains Concentration as if on a spell. It gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for the duration. This form does not let it pass through creatures or solid objects.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 2 legendary actions and refreshes them at the start of its turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Treacherous Ice (1 action). Pick a point the dragon sees up to 120 ft. away. Ice coats the ground in a 20-ft. radius centered there. It is difficult terrain for creatures other than lunar dragons and lasts 10 minutes or until this option is used again.

sections.title: Lair
lines: The dragon burrows a cave system inside a barren moon. Hidden chambers hold its hoard, often with spelljamming helms taken from trespassing ships. The caves may shelter springs, vents, wild plants, or life adapted to the moon.

sections.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects near the lair.
Black Frost. This frost coats the ground and kills ordinary plants within 3 miles of the lair.
Haunting Moan. The dragon chooses whether the moan grows louder or fainter as visitors approach. It is audible within 3 miles.
Moon Devils. Funnels of dust and frost intercept creatures within 1 mile of the lair. Each moon devil uses the Air Elemental stat block, acts independently, and deals cold damage in place of bludgeoning.
The moan and moon devils vanish when the dragon dies. The frost fades over 1d10 days and plants can recover.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The dragon can turn a failed save into a success.
Tunneler. Burrowing through solid rock costs twice the normal movement and leaves a tunnel 20 ft. in diameter.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and its speed becomes 0 through the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and its speed stays the same.

sections.title: Bonus actions
lines: Phase (3/day). The dragon turns partly incorporeal while it maintains Concentration as if on a spell. It gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for the duration. This form does not let it pass through creatures or solid objects.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon has 3 legendary actions and refreshes them at the start of its turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Treacherous Ice (1 action). Pick a point the dragon sees up to 120 ft. away. Ice coats the ground in a 20-ft. radius centered there. It is difficult terrain for creatures other than lunar dragons and lasts 10 minutes or until this option is used again.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. of the dragon makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 12 (1d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

sections.title: Lair
lines: The dragon burrows a cave system inside a barren moon. Hidden chambers hold its hoard, often with spelljamming helms taken from trespassing ships. The caves may shelter springs, vents, wild plants, or life adapted to the moon.

sections.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects near the lair.
Black Frost. This frost coats the ground and kills ordinary plants within 6 miles of the lair.
Haunting Moan. The dragon chooses whether the moan grows louder or fainter as visitors approach. It is audible within 6 miles.
Moon Devils. Funnels of dust and frost intercept creatures within 1 mile of the lair. Each moon devil uses the Air Elemental stat block, acts independently, and deals cold damage in place of bludgeoning.
The moan and moon devils vanish when the dragon dies. The frost fades over 1d10 days and plants can recover.

sections.title: Classification
lines: Medium swarm of Tiny aberrations, typically lawful evil

sections.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces or traverse ceilings without an ability check.
Swarm. The swarm can enter another creature's space, and other creatures can enter its space. The swarm fits through gaps large enough for one Tiny neogi hatchling. It can neither regain hit points nor gain temporary hit points.

sections.title: Actions
lines: Swarm of Bites. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Deal 22 (6d6 + 1) poison damage on a hit, or 11 (3d6 + 1) if the swarm is at half its maximum hit points or fewer. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Devil's Sight. The void hunter's darkvision works in magical darkness.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Bite once and Claw twice, or use Eldritch Bolt twice.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage on a hit. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It can end the condition with a successful repeat save at the end of any of its turns.

Eldritch Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Deal 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage on a hit.
Spellcasting. Cast Dimension Door or Invisibility using Charisma. Each spell is available once per day.

sections.title: Bonus actions
lines: Enslave (recharges after a short or long rest). Choose a creature the void hunter can see within 30 ft. If the target fails a DC 14 Wisdom save, the void hunter magically charms it for 1 day. The effect also ends if the hunter dies or the two are more than 1 mile apart. While charmed, the target follows the hunter's commands and cannot take reactions. The two can communicate telepathically up to 1 mile apart. Each time the target takes damage, it can repeat the save to end the effect on a success.
